---
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      api_purpose:
        description: Published API validation by default; ordinary CI selects development.
        type: string
        default: published
    outputs:
      candidate_sha:
        description: Exact fully validated caller candidate.
        value: ${{ jobs.pr-gate.outputs.candidate_sha }}
      published_api_candidate_sha:
        description: Exact candidate with published-purpose API success.
        value: ${{ jobs.pr-gate.outputs.published_api_candidate_sha }}

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  validation-plan:
    name: Validation plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      plan: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.plan }}
      profile: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.profile }}
      select_rust: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_rust }}
      select_msrv: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_msrv }}
      select_dependencies: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_dependencies }}
      select_documentation: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_documentation }}
      select_api: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_api }}
      select_coverage: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_coverage }}
      select_lockfile_release_age: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind exact candidate and trusted policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          policy-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          config-path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Select exact-revision validation plan
        id: plan
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          POLICY_CONFIG: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci plan \
            --repository-root source --config "${POLICY_CONFIG}" \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --github-output "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
  rust:
    name: Rust quality
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_rust == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-rust-ci.yml@1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
      config_path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      task: rust-quality
  coverage:
    name: Coverage ratchet
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_coverage == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-rust-ci.yml@1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
      config_path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      task: coverage
  msrv:
    name: MSRV
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_msrv == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-rust-ci.yml@1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
      config_path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      task: msrv
  dependencies:
    name: Dependency and license policy
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_dependencies == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-rust-dependencies.yml@1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
      config_path: scripts/validation-policy.json
  api:
    name: Public API compatibility
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_api == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-rust-semver.yml@1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
      config_path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      package: compose-lens
      api_purpose: ${{ inputs.api_purpose || 'development' }}
  documentation:
    name: Repository files and documentation
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_documentation == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository with release history
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Install canonical shared Node.js toolchain
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-node
        with:
          automation-sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json
      - name: Install locked Node file-quality tools
        run: |
          npm ci --ignore-scripts
          printf '%s\n' "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/node_modules/.bin" >> "${GITHUB_PATH}"
      - name: Install checksum-pinned native file-quality tools
        run: |
          bash scripts/install-host-tools.sh "${RUNNER_TEMP}/compose-lens-file-tools"
          printf '%s\n' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/compose-lens-file-tools" >> "${GITHUB_PATH}"
      - name: Check non-Rust file formatting and lint
        run: bash scripts/check-files.sh --check
      - name: Test release metadata policy
        run: bash scripts/test-release-metadata.sh
      - name: Check release metadata and changelog
        env:
          RELEASE_METADATA_MODE: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && startsWith(github.head_ref, 'release-plz-') && '--release' || '--development' }}
        run: bash scripts/check-release-metadata.sh "${RELEASE_METADATA_MODE}"
      - name: Check local documentation links without network access
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@e7477775783ea5526144ba13e8db5eec57747ce8 # v2.9.0
        with:
          args: >-
            --config lychee.toml --root-dir '${{ github.workspace }}' --offline
            './**/*.md'
          fail: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Check repository Python automation
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation ruff check --config pyproject.toml scripts
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation ruff format --check --config pyproject.toml scripts
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation ty check --project . scripts
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python scripts/test-automation-contract.py

  lockfile-release-age:
    name: Dependency eligibility
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age == 'true'
    permissions:
      actions: read
      statuses: read
      contents: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-dependency-wait.yml@1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}

  pr-gate:
    name: Required CI
    if: always()
    needs:
      - validation-plan
      - rust
      - msrv
      - dependencies
      - api
      - documentation
      - coverage
      - lockfile-release-age
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind exact candidate and trusted policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          policy-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          config-path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Require selected jobs and independently planned skips
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 1cf96f5a667d96e66c119753cf7814e22e0dee7e
          POLICY_CONFIG: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          PLAN_JSON: ${{ needs.validation-plan.outputs.plan }}
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci gate \
            --repository-root source --config "${POLICY_CONFIG}" \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --plan-json "${PLAN_JSON}" --needs-json "${NEEDS_JSON}"
      - name: Expose purpose-bound successful candidate
        id: result
        env:
          API_PURPOSE: ${{ inputs.api_purpose || 'development' }}
          PUBLISHED_API_CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ needs.api.outputs.published_api_candidate_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${API_PURPOSE}" in
            published)
              test "${PUBLISHED_API_CANDIDATE_SHA}" = "${GITHUB_SHA}"
              printf 'published_api_candidate_sha=%s\n' "${GITHUB_SHA}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
              ;;
            development) ;;
            *) exit 1 ;;
          esac
          printf 'candidate_sha=%s\n' "${GITHUB_SHA}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      candidate_sha: ${{ steps.result.outputs.candidate_sha }}
      published_api_candidate_sha: ${{ steps.result.outputs.published_api_candidate_sha }}
